_comment: TEMPLATE — copy this file to main.parameters.local.json and fill in your values. The .local.json file is gitignored. Never commit a populated parameters file with real values.

location._comment: Choose from Tier-1 list in docs/02-prerequisites.md § 11: eastus2 / swedencentral / australiaeast / japaneast

workloadName._comment: Short workload name (2-8 chars). Used in resource naming.

embeddingModelName._comment: Cost-down option: text-embedding-3-small (1536 dim instead of 3072)

embeddingModelVersion._comment: Leave empty to let Azure pick latest GA. Pin a version (e.g. '1') for reproducibility.

embeddingModelTpm._comment: TPM in units of 1000. 10 = 10K TPM (demo). Bump to 50+ for production indexing throughput.

chatModelName._comment: OPT-IN. Leave EMPTY (default) to skip the chat deployment — the locked design (Copilot Studio + AI Search + integrated vectorizer) does NOT consume a chat completion model; Copilot Studio uses its own host model. Set to `gpt-4o` (or `gpt-4o-mini` for cost-down) only when an engagement explicitly needs a chat endpoint (custom app code, Foundry agent runtime, BYOM Copilot Studio).

chatModelTpm._comment: TPM in units of 1000. Ignored when chatModelName is empty. Only relevant when opting in.

searchSku._comment: Standard (S1) MINIMUM — semantic ranker not available on Free or Basic. Use standard2 / standard3 for high query volume or large indexes.

deployerPrincipalId._comment: Object ID of the identity running the post-deploy script. When set, the deployment grants Search Service Contributor + Search Index Data Contributor on the AI Search service (admin keys are disabled). Find your own value with: az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv. For CI: the pipeline's service principal / workload identity object ID. Leave blank to assign the roles manually.

deployerPrincipalType._comment: User (interactive az login) or ServicePrincipal (CI/CD federated workload identity).

deployWebApp._comment: OPT-IN. Set true to also provision the optional web-app hosting platform (Container Apps environment, ACR, Log Analytics, user-assigned managed identity) for the standalone chat front end (docs/09). The container image is built + deployed afterwards by scripts/deploy-webapp.ps1. Leave false for the Copilot Studio path.
